companyDescription: Multi-domain autonomous defense platform · drone/counter-UAS systems + Sentrycs + DZYNE Technologies forming the Ondas Sentinel division · FY26 revenue guide $525M+ · Q2 2026 earnings Aug 13
priceNote: Premarket $9.38 (+3.0% vs Friday's $9.11 close) — a fourth-plus straight up session, now +21.6% over the trailing week heading into the Aug 13 print (3 days out). New since the last report: Ondas will provide counter-drone protection for the Jacksonville Jaguars (commercial/venue-security win) and DZYNE was awarded a new $6M AFRL contract — both incremental positives layered on the DZYNE/Barnea momentum already in the stock.
summary: Ondas keeps grinding higher into its confirmed Aug 13, 2026 Q2 print, now just 3 days out and up 21.6% over the trailing week. Two fresh, real data points since the last report: a new AFRL $6M contract awarded to DZYNE, and a commercial counter-drone deal to protect the Jacksonville Jaguars — both incremental confirmations of the platform-diversification thesis (defense + commercial venue security) rather than one dominant headline. The core near-term question is unchanged and now more urgent: can the company show it's on track for the raised $525M+ FY26 guide (which implies ~$406M of H2 revenue) when it reports in 3 days? Consensus still averages a $19.81 target (~111% upside from here), but the stock is increasingly priced for a clean beat-and-raise.

catalysts.name: Q2 2026 Earnings — CONFIRMED
catalysts.description: Confirmed for Aug 13, 2026, 8:30am ET call — now 3 days out. Market wants to see the raised $525M+ FY26 guide (implying $406M of H2 revenue) validated in reported numbers and order pace, plus management commentary on DZYNE/Sentinel integration and the new AFRL and Jacksonville Jaguars deals.

catalysts.name: AFRL $6M Contract (DZYNE) + Jacksonville Jaguars Counter-Drone Deal
catalysts.description: New since the last report: the Air Force Research Laboratory awarded DZYNE a $6M contract, and Ondas will provide counter-drone protection for the Jacksonville Jaguars — a commercial/venue-security win that diversifies the revenue base beyond pure defense procurement.

catalysts.name: DZYNE Technologies / Ondas Sentinel Division
catalysts.description: The $875.8M DZYNE acquisition (closed) remains the structural driver behind the raised FY26 guide — DZYNE alone is expected to add ~$190-191M revenue in 2026 and $300M+ in 2027.

risks: 44% of the float is short — can supercharge a squeeze on a beat, but just as violently amplify a drawdown on a miss around the Aug 13 print, now only 3 days away
The raised guide implies $406M of H2 2026 revenue — a large, specific number the market will hold management to on Aug 13, with limited room for a soft explanation
DZYNE deal added ~85M new shares (~13.8% of shares outstanding); 45M shares remain under a 6-month lock-up that could pressure the float when it expires
Drone-defense peers have sold off hard even on strong fundamentals — Red Cat (RCAT) fell 26% in a trailing month on macro + Pentagon budget-timing headwinds despite record backlogs

Market cap has grown roughly 1,300%+ off 52-week lows — a re-rate this large raises real questions about how much of the DZYNE/Sentinel/commercial-diversification story is already priced in ahead of Aug 13
Sustaining 10x+ YoY order-growth comps gets mechanically harder every subsequent quarter

estimateDates.note: CONFIRMED — 8:30am ET call, 3 days out. Market wants the $525M+ FY26 guide (implying $406M H2 revenue) validated

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed held at 3.50-3.75% on Jul 29, 2026 (3 hawkish dissents), though the weak Jul NFP (-23K, Aug 7) has since pulled hike odds down sharply. CPI lands Aug 12, one day before Ondas' own Aug 13 print — a genuine event cluster.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Core inflation remains above target — a headwind for high-beta small/mid caps like Ondas even with real fundamental momentum.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Drone-defense peers have sold off hard on macro + Pentagon budget-timing headwinds even with record backlogs (RCAT -26% in a trailing month) — showing this high-beta sub-sector amplifies broad risk-off moves. Ondas carries the same exposure.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — Pentagon/defense-contract demand is largely macro-independent, but CPI (Aug 12) lands the day before Ondas' own earnings (Aug 13), stacking two high-stakes events back to back for a stock already carrying 44% short interest.
